body.p: Reconsideration and allowance in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks are respectfully requested.
Upon entry of this Amendment, claims 1-7 and 13-15 will be pending in the present application. Claims 8-12 have been cancelled.

Claims 1-3, 5-7 and 13-15 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102 as being anticipated by U.S. Patent Publication No. 2020/0250406 Al to Wang et al. ("Wang"). Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection for the reasons presented below.

Claim 1 recites "receiving an image depicting a display screen of a patient monitoring system, wherein the image depicting the display screen of the patient monitor contains a depiction of at least one vital signs data value of said patient." Wang does not teach or suggest such a feature.

Wang describes extracting vital sign information for a patient from an image of a scene with a patient (e.g., a waiting room) that has been captured. The '406 patent publication, [0034]. Wang does not teach or suggest either receiving an image depicting a display screen of a patient monitor, or that the image depicting the display screen contains a depiction of at least one vital sign data value of the patient. An image of a scene containing patients is not a depiction of a display screen of a patient monitor, and extracting vital signs camera information (as described in Wang) is not a depiction of at least one vital signs data value of a patient.
For the reasons presented above, Applicant respectfully submits that independent

claim lis not anticipated or rendered obvious by the cited references. In addition, claims 2-7 and 13- 15 are also not anticipated or rendered obvious due to their dependency from independent claim 1. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that the above rejection of claims 1-7 and 13-15 be withdrawn.

It should be noted that Applicant has not addressed each rejection of the dependent claims. Any rejection of a dependent claim not specifically addressed is not to be construed as an admission by Applicant of the correctness of that rejection. Rather, Applicant believes that the independent claims are patentably distinguishable over the cited references for the reasons noted above, so that the rejection of the dependent claims need not be addressed at this time. Applicant reserves the right to address the rejection of any dependent claim at a later time should that become warranted.
All objections and rejections have been addressed. It is respectfully submitted that the present application is in condition for allowance and a Notice to the effect is earnestly solicited.
BY: /Anne W. Pearlman/ Anne W. Pearlman, Reg. No. 69,097PHILIPS IP&S
